name: PEPE
rootCause: PEPE said on Twitter that 16 trillion pieces of PEPE were sold yesterday because three former members deleted the multi-signature permissions after stealing tokens. However, Jeremy Cahen, founder of the NFT market Not Larva Labs, issued a post saying that the "truth" announced by PEPE was a complete lie, and said that he and the community were used by the PEPE team. On August 26, PEPE tweeted that PEPE's Telegram group is currently locked, the group owner's old Telegram account was hacked, and the group has been taken over by hackers.

descriptions.text: PEPE said on Twitter that 16 trillion pieces of PEPE were sold yesterday because three former members deleted the multi-signature permissions after stealing tokens. However, Jeremy Cahen, founder of the NFT market Not Larva Labs, issued a post saying that the "truth" announced by PEPE was a complete lie, and said that he and the community were used by the PEPE team. On August 26, PEPE tweeted that PEPE's Telegram group is currently locked, the group owner's old Telegram account was hacked, and the group has been taken over by hackers.

Between August 24 and 26, 2023, insider action on PEPE’s Ethereum multisig treasury wallet enabled the unauthorized transfer of approximately 16 trillion PEPE tokens (worth ~$15 million) to exchange deposit accounts. No direct on-chain evidence of the wallet addresses or transaction hashes has been disclosed in public, but the event and mechanism are widely reported. The multisig treasury wallet’s signer set and threshold could be reduced without transparent, delayed, or decentralized governance. Insiders lowered the threshold from five-of-eight to two-of-eight, allowing them to transfer funds to personal and exchange addresses without broader team consent.
